Limited | editor = N.Rahul Kumar | deputy_editor = | circulation = 375,661 | circulation_date = 2022 | headquarters = [[Hyderabad, India]] | ISSN = | website = {{URL|www.andhrajyothy.com}} }} '''''Andhra Jyothi''''' ({{langx|te|ఆంధ్రజ్యోతి}}; {{lit|The light of [[Andhra]]}}) is the third largest circulated [[Telugu language|Telugu]] language daily newspaper of [[India]]. It is sold mostly in the states of [[Andhra Pradesh]] and [[Telangana]]. It was founded by [[K. L. N. Prasad]], an industrialist, on 1 July 1960.{{Cite book |last=బెందాళం |first=క్రిష్ణారావు |title="మేటి పత్రికలు-ఆంధ్రజ్యోతి", వార్తలు ఎలా రాయాలి |publisher=ఋషి ప్రచురణలు |year=2006 |pages=412–413}}{{Cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=fUxDAAAAYAAJ&q=andhra+jyothi |title=India Today |date=1989 |publisher=Thomson Living Media India Limited |pages=48 |language=en}}{{Cite book |last=Kandula |first=Ramesh |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=DYpoDwAAQBAJ&dq=andhra+jyothy+founded+year&pg=PT40 |title=Maverick Messiah: A Political Biography of N.T. Rama Rao |date=2021-01-25 |publisher=Penguin Random House India Private Limited |isbn=978-93-5305-223-2 |language=en}} It is one of the oldest running [[Telugu language]] daily newspapers. It was taken over by [[Vemuri Radhakrishna]], also known as R. K., in 2002, who is also the managing director. == Details == The paper is published from 21 centers across the states of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu. [[Vemuri Radhakrishna]], a senior journalist turned entrepreneur, is its managing director, and journalist N.Rahul Kumar is its editor. It is the third-largest circulated Telugu daily, according to the Audit Bureau of Circulation (ABC), and is known for its dynamic political reporting. ''Andhra Jyothi'' has a vast reporting network across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, and also has a considerable presence in New Delhi, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Orissa, and Chhattisgarh. The group also owns a Telugu TV news channel, [[ABN Andhra Jyothi]], and a weekly magazine, ''[[Navya weekly|Navya]]''.{{Cite web |url=https://www.andhrajyothy.com/about-us/ |title=about-us |access-date=2023-04-08 |website=andhrajyothy.com}} According to the Audit Bureau of Circulation for the H12022, ''Andhra Jyothi'' had a circulation of 375,661, ranked at 17th place among daily newspapers in India.{{Cite web |title=Highest Circulated Dailies, Weeklies & Magazines amongst Member Publications (across languages) |url=http://www.auditbureau.org/files/JJ%202022%20Highest%20Circulated%20%28across%20languages%29.pdf?_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=te&_x_tr_hl=te&_x_tr_pto=tc&_x_tr_sch=http |access-date=2023-03-08 |website=Auditbureau}} Its circulation during Q2 2019 was 664,352.{{cite web| url= https://www.auditbureau.org/files/JD%202019%20Highest%20Circulated%20(language%20wise).pdf| title=Highest Circulated Daily Newspapers (language wise)| publisher=[[Audit Bureau of Circulations (India)|Audit Bureau of Circulations]] |access-date=5 January 2020}} Circulation dropped by 43.45% over a three year period.{{when|date=July 2025}} == Criticism== Though it initially started as a neutral and non-political party oriented newspaper and was later taken over by a different organisations, the newspaper under this organization became an arch-rival to the previous [[Chief minister of Andhra Pradesh|Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh]] [[Y. S. Jagan Mohan Reddy]] and his political party, [[YSR Congress Party]].{{Cite web|date=2019-04-01|title=Telugu media outlet carries fake survey on AP polls, Lokniti-CSDS calls them out|url=https://www.thenewsminute.com/article/telugu-media-outlet-carries-fake-survey-ap-polls-lokniti-csds-calls-them-out-99290|access-date=2021-03-10|publisher=[[The News Minute]]|language=en}} The newspaper and its managing director Vemuri Radha Krishna are often criticized for publishing news in support of the [[N. Chandrababu Naidu|Chandrababu Naidu]] led [[Telugu Desam Party]]. ==See also== * ''[[Eenadu]]'' * ''[[Sakshi (newspaper)|Sakshi]]'' == References == {{Reflist}} == External links == * [https://www.andhrajyothy.com/ ''Andhra Jyothi'' official website] {{Newspapers in India}} [[Category:Telugu-language newspapers]] [[Category:1960 establishments in Andhra Pradesh]] [[Category:Daily newspapers published in India]] [[Category:Newspapers published in Vijayawada]] [[Category:Newspapers published in Hyderabad, India]]
